fault: a crash or failure after the R2 put and before the D1 insert committed: crash_after or ambiguous on the put, or crash_before or error on the insert (the seed decides which is found first)
description: An upload handler puts the file in R2 under a fresh key, then inserts the row that names it. A failure in between leaves an object no row names, and the client's retry uploads under another key, so the first object is orphaned for good.
